root_cause: rich.markup.escape() only doubled backslashes that immediately precede a tag-like '[...]' match. A value ending in a lone backslash (e.g. 'C:\\' i.e. C:\) was returned unchanged, so when interpolated as f"[red]{escape(value)}[/red]" the trailing backslash escaped the following closing tag and printed 'C:[/red]'.
best_solution: Fix it in escape() (the function the issue says fails), not in render(). After the existing regex substitution, if the result ends with a single backslash (endswith('\\') and not endswith('\\\\')), append one more backslash so the escaped string ends in an escaped backslash; render() then turns '\\\\[' back into a literal backslash followed by a real tag. This works because escape's contract is 'safe to embed next to any markup', and the only place a trailing backslash hurts is the boundary with the next tag the caller appends.
acceptable_alternatives: Any escape()-side change that doubles an odd run of trailing backslashes (the issue's own regex (?<![\\])(?:[\\][\\])*[\\]$) passes. v4 also made the tag regex lazy ((\\*?)) which was harmless here. Changing render() instead is NOT acceptable: it alters how existing escaped markup renders and breaks test_render_escape.
hidden_test_demands: tests/test_markup.py::test_escape_backslash_end: escape('C:\\') == 'C:\\\\' (Python literals: C:\ becomes C:\\); f'[red]{escape(value)}[/red]' == '[red]C:\\\\[/red]'; Text.from_markup(...).plain == 'C:\\' and spans == [Span(0, 3, 'red')]. Existing test_render_escape must keep passing (render semantics unchanged).
locating_signals: Title 'Fix escaping trailing backslash' plus linked issue #2987 titled 'Escape vs trailing backslash' naming rich.markup.escape and giving a repro and a candidate regex. The statement itself only has the title and URL, so the function name comes from the word 'escaping' and the issue text; rich/markup.py:escape is the only escape function in the markup module.
our_outcome_summary: v4 PASSED (added the endswith check in escape(), same as gold, plus a harmless lazy-quantifier regex tweak). v6 FAILED: no source change at all, only an empty fix.diff and a verify_fix.py script (test_escape_backslash_end fails, escape unchanged). v7 FAILED: patched render() to collapse trailing '\\\\' into one backslash instead of fixing escape(); test_escape_backslash_end still fails and it broke existing test_render_escape. v8 FAILED: unrelated edit in rich/pretty.py (rstrip -> removesuffix) plus a new test file; markup.py untouched.
generalizable_lesson: When a statement is just a PR title plus an issue link, the verb/noun in the title names the function to change ('escaping' -> escape()); fix the producer function named there, not its consumer (render/parse), because changing the consumer alters existing behavior that other tests pin. Before finishing, confirm the diff actually modifies a source file (not only scratch/verify scripts) and that the repro from the issue now passes through the public API.
